subject: English
stimulus: (a) It matters little to me whether ⎯⎯. (b) He pretended as if ⎯⎯. (c) If I had the wings of a bird, ⎯⎯. (d) Take your umbrella lest ⎯⎯. (e) Hardly had he started for school ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) It matters little to me whether you go with me or not. (b) He pretended as if he had known everything about the matter. (c) If I had the wings of a bird, I would fly in the sky. (d) Take your umbrella lest you should get wet. (e) Hardly had he started for school when the rain began.
